headline: PH on track to hit 10 GW new power capacity by 2028
summary: Energy officials said the Philippines is on track to add 10 gigawatts of new power capacity by the end of the Marcos administration. More than 6 GW was already completed by December, with private investment cited.
why: Power capacity additions reflect the pace of energy infrastructure investment, which affects utilities, developers and industrial costs. Government targets shape private sector project pipelines.
